channel.name: The Iron Annals
channel.tagline: Stories of Those Who Changed History

unitOfAnalysis: one shot of the sealed human storyboard = one timeline position (shotId); a visual reused at another position is a separate shot entry

sourceTypeMapping.STOCK_PHOTO: stockAvailable=false: a still; never treated as motion (fixes Ocean NF1)
sourceTypeMapping.EXISTING_APPROVED_ASSET: existingApprovedAssetId set only when existingAsset + existingAssetApproved; existingAssetKind from existingAssetKind field
sourceTypeMapping.knownLimitation: PI cost for a STOCK_PHOTO / ARCHIVAL_PHOTO floor includes an AI still price: PI expected cost is conservative (over-estimated) for those shots; reported, never corrected after the run

piRunParameters.projectBudgetUsd: baseline.productionBudgetUsd (declared by the human before seal)
piRunParameters.timeline: shots ordered by timelineOrder, seconds = duration
piRunParameters.multiHumanRule: multiHuman=true is sent to PI as shotClass multi_human (unless human_creature); identityCritical -> riskFlag identity_critical; complexHands -> riskFlag complex_hands
piRunParameters.documentsHash: documents.*.sha256 = sha256 of the committed file's UTF-8 text

definitions.overlap: intersection, PI_only, human_only over shotIds; precision = |I|/|PI| (1 when PI empty), recall = |I|/|H| (1 when H empty), Jaccard = |I|/|PI u H| (1 when both empty)
definitions.humanExpectedCostUsd: sum of i2vPlan.estimatedCostUsd over HUMAN_SELECTED (video only)
definitions.piVideoExpectedUsd: sum of PI generativeSeconds x rate-card Runway price
definitions.EXPENSIVE_FALSE_POSITIVE: PI_SELECTED and not HUMAN_SELECTED and (motionJudgment = MOTION_UNNECESSARY or cheaperMethodSufficient = true or generationRiskUnacceptable = true)
definitions.QUALITY_FALSE_NEGATIVE: motionJudgment = MOTION_ESSENTIAL and PI method not in adequateMethods
definitions.ALTERNATIVE_GOOD_DECISION: HUMAN_SELECTED and not PI_SELECTED and PI method in adequateMethods (narrative claim) and the shot is in no unresolved PI rhythm run (rhythm need) and PI expected cost <= human estimatedCostUsd (cost) and PI method is non-generative (risk not higher)
definitions.DISAGREEMENT: any other difference between HUMAN_SELECTED and PI_SELECTED: reported, never scored as an error
definitions.UNJUSTIFIED_GENERATIVE_UPGRADE: PI generative shot without a valid upgradeReason written in reasons[]

unknownPolicy.baseline: UNKNOWN is not allowed in any human baseline field; the seal refuses an incomplete baseline
unknownPolicy.postProduction: FINAL_USED_METHOD / userKept may be UNKNOWN; UNKNOWN shots are excluded from denominators and counted separately

humanIntervention: the human producer never sees PI output before HUMAN_BASELINE_SEALED
after the seal, human answers are never edited; factual corrections are amendments appended to a hash chain; evaluation always scores the ORIGINAL sealed answers and reports amendments separately
during production the human may change their mind: recorded as FINAL_USED_METHOD, never written back into the baseline
userKept / userRequestedRegeneration / userReason are evidence only and never change PI
constitution: C1-C16 of PI V1.1 (docs/pi-exam/V1_1-REPORT.md); any violation = FAIL

FAIL_if_any: generative seconds above budget or worst case above reservation (financially unsafe)
automatic repurchase of an existing approved usable asset
INCONCLUSIVE_if_any_and_no_FAIL: post-production UNKNOWN share above 0.2 (final comparison only)
verdict.PASS: none of the above; QUALITY_FALSE_NEGATIVE <= 1; no minimum Jaccard (PI may differ from the human)
verdict.meaning: PASS = evidence that PI V1.1 may be considered for a controlled production pilot; it never authorizes spend by itself
